modify.note: Fix three bugs in the weekly calendar's display of overlapping events. Each Calendar instance must get its own isolated weekly-view state instead of sharing one global Zustand store, so changing dates or events in one calendar on a page no longer affects other calendars. Overlapping events must stay inside their own day column even with 10 or more (up to 20+) overlapping events, and event positioning must no longer use the inset-x-1 class that sets both left and right and conflicts with the inline width.

add_nodes.label: Weekly view overlap layout
add_nodes.summary: Pure layout helpers that place overlapping events in a weekly-view day column.
add_nodes.description: Sorts a day's events, groups those that overlap in time, and computes a cascading horizontal offset, width and stacking order for each event so the cascade never exceeds the column width.
add_nodes.note: Overlapping events are grouped and cascaded, with each event's offset plus width kept within the day column (allowing a safety margin) no matter how many events overlap; the base width, offset step, z-index and margin have defaults that callers can override.

add_edges.label: event overlap layout
add_edges.note: The weekly view's event list takes each event's left offset, width and z-index from the overlap layout instead of computing the cascade itself.
